### E&F Currency Merge -- GENERATED FILE, DO NOT EDIT
### Rebuild with tools/regen_ef_currency_merge.py after any E&F or hotfix update.
###
### Source: the same tag -> company table as zz_ef_cm_bank_ownership.txt.
###
### SYNTAX CONFIRMED IN GAME 2026-08-22: the guess was right. The engine ran
### add_company_monopoly = bt:building_bank in company scope and answered with
### its own assertion -- pdx_assert.cpp:641, "already have monopoly granted to a
### company" -- which is a complaint about a second grant, not about the syntax.
###
### How it was inferred, kept because the same reading works for the other
### undocumented effects: add_company_monopoly and
### company_has_building_type_monopoly are named in vanilla's
### effect_localization / trigger_localization but called from nowhere in
### vanilla or in any mod in this repo, so their shape is read off the loc
### strings: ADD_COMPANY_MONOPOLY_FIRST is "[COMPANY.GetName] gains a company
### monopoly on [TARGET_BUILDING_TYPE.GetName]", and a `first` slot of COMPANY is
### how effect_localization marks the scope an effect runs in -- hence company
### scope, one building type as the value. `bt:building_bank` is the one
### confirmed part (mp1_charters_of_commerce_achievements.txt:146).
###
### CHECK error.log AFTER THE FIRST RUN. Kept in its own file so that if the
### game rejects it, nothing else in the mod goes down with it.
###
### This is the direct grant. The +1 free charter on
### zz_ef_cm_central_bank_charter stays either way: it is what lets the player
### hand the company a monopoly charter without spending one of the country's
### four, which is the route the game itself offers.
